script: Hey! Okay, check this out guys. I get asked ALL the time, what ages does Elephant Learning cover? We accept students of all ages, and cover from counting through algebra. We have seen success with students as young as two and helped college students with college algebra. If your student is working on any of these subjects, then Elephant Learning can help them learn years of mathematics in just a few months. Check it out okay?
